philosophy.title: 我们的烘焙哲学
philosophy.p1: 《麦日记》，是我们与面粉、水和酵母对话的日记。这里记录的并非冰冷的配方，而是每一次烘焙背后的灵感、情绪与故事。
philosophy.p2: 我坚信，最好的味道源于最纯粹的食材和最耐心的守候。在这里，我想与你分享这份源自手作的温暖，以及烘焙带给我的简单快乐。让我们一起，用双手创造生活中的美好点滴。

guides.del_box1_title: 🏡 1. Tanjong Sepat 本地送货 & 到店自提
guides.del_box1_desc: 麦日记工坊位于 Tanjong Sepat。本地提供送货上门与店面自提服务。
guides.del_box2_desc: Banting 地区需事先沟通安排配送。其他较远区域暂时仅支持到店自提。
guides.care_bread_rt_desc: 密封避光可保存 2-3 天。
guides.care_bread_fz_desc: 切片密封冷冻可保存 3-4 周（⚠️ 切勿直接冷藏，冷藏会加速水分流失与淀粉老化）。
guides.care_bread_rh_desc: 表面轻喷水雾，预热 180°C 烤箱/空气炸锅烘烤 3-5 分钟恢复外脆内软。
guides.care_cake_rf_desc: 2°C - 6°C 冷藏保存，建议 2 天内食用完毕。
guides.care_cake_sg_desc: 冷藏取出后室温静置 10-15 分钟口感更丝滑。
guides.faq_q1: ⏱️ 1. 为什么要提前至少 1 天预定？
guides.faq_a1: 我们的酸种欧包采用传统纯手作与天然酵母发酵，需经过 18 小时以上的低温慢发酵排单。因此不接受突发即时订单，请提前预定以便为您准备面团。
guides.faq_a2: 选好商品点「发送订单」后，订单会直接送达麦日记。您可以随时在「我的订单」（购物车底部入口）查看进度：待确认 → 已确认 → 制作中 → 已完成 → 已送达。我们确认后会在订单聊天里回复您，有任何问题也可以直接在里面留言～

detail.inquire_btn: 询问预售 / 上市时间
detail.storage_bread:
• 常温密封：可保存 2-3 天。
• 切片密封冷冻：可保存 3-4 周。
（⚠️ 请勿直接冷藏，冷藏会加速水分流失与淀粉老化）。
detail.storage_cake: 需冷藏保存（2°C - 6°C）。建议 2 天内食用完毕，以享受最佳口感与奶香。
detail.reheat_bread:
1. 喷水：表面轻喷少量水雾。
2. 烤箱/空气炸锅：预热 180°C 烘烤 3-5 分钟。
3. 平底锅：中火无油干煎切片至两面复酥金黄即可。
detail.reheat_cake: 冷藏取出后，建议室温静置 10-15 分钟回温后再食用，乳酪慕斯口感将更加丝滑顺柔。

diary_stage.entry1_title: 十一月三日 · 酥皮与温暖秋阳
diary_stage.entry1_content: 今天午后，阳光落在开酥台面上。看着发酵箱里的面团慢慢鼓起，像极了睡在麦堆里的牛角包熊。烘焙不仅是精确的配方，更是让时间慢下来的温存魔法。
diary_stage.entry2_title: 十一月十日 · 刚出炉的柔软呼噜
diary_stage.entry2_content: 刚出炉的生吐司带着浓郁的生乳香气。猫咪趴在温热的布巾旁打呼噜，整个屋子都漫溢着面粉与黄油受热后散发的幸福味道。
diary_stage.entry3_title: 十一月十七日 · 肉桂与秋日的甜梦
diary_stage.entry3_content: 在面团里揉入了肉桂干花，烤箱运转时，微甜的香气漫出窗外。那一刻我明白，烘焙更像是一场温柔的创作，希望能带给你一整天的好心情。

philosophy.title: Our Baking Philosophy
philosophy.p1: MaiRiji is our diary of conversation with flour, water, and yeast. It is not only about precise recipes, but also about the inspiration, emotion, and stories hidden behind every bake.
philosophy.p2: We believe the best flavor comes from honest ingredients and patient care. Here, we share the warmth of handmade baking and the quiet joy it brings to everyday life.

guides.card1_desc: Tanjong Sepat home delivery & pickup rules, Banting area arrangements.

guides.del_box1_desc: Our bakery is located in Tanjong Sepat. We offer local home delivery and self-pickup.
guides.del_box2_desc: Banting delivery is available by prior arrangement. For other areas, self-pickup is currently required.
guides.care_bread_rt_desc: Keep sealed and away from light for 2-3 days.
guides.care_bread_fz_desc: Slice and freeze sealed for up to 3-4 weeks (⚠️ Do not refrigerate, as it dries out the bread).
guides.care_bread_rh_desc: Mist with water, preheat oven/air fryer to 180°C and toast for 3-5 minutes.
guides.care_cake_rf_desc: Keep refrigerated at 2°C - 6°C. Consume within 2 days for best flavor.
guides.care_cake_sg_desc: Rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes after unchilling for a silkier texture.
guides.faq_q1: ⏱️ 1. Why order at least 1 day in advance?
guides.faq_a1: Our sourdough undergoes a slow fermentation of over 18 hours. We bake to order and cannot accept instant same-day orders, so please order ahead.
guides.faq_a2: After choosing your items, tap "Send Order" and it goes straight to MaiRiJi. Track your order anytime in "My Orders" (bottom of the cart drawer): Pending → Confirmed → Baking → Ready → Delivered. We will reply in the order chat once confirmed, and you can message us there anytime.

detail.storage_bread:
• Room Temperature: Keep sealed for 2-3 days.
• Freezer: Slice and freeze sealed for up to 4 weeks.
(Avoid refrigeration as it dries out the bread).
detail.storage_cake: Keep refrigerated (2°C - 6°C). Consume within 2 days for optimal freshness and texture.
detail.reheat_bread:
1. Mist: Lightly spray water on the bread surface.
2. Oven/Air Fryer: Preheat to 180°C and bake for 3-5 minutes.
3. Pan Fry: Toast sliced bread in a dry pan on medium heat until crispy.
detail.reheat_cake: Take out from fridge and let it rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes before serving for a softer, silkier texture.

diary_stage.hint: ✨ Tap the sleeping pets to read their baking diary
diary_stage.entry1_content: Sunlight streamed across the wooden table as the dough slowly puffed up in the prover, just like a sleeping croissant bear. Baking is not only about precise recipes, but also a gentle art of letting time slow down.
diary_stage.entry2_content: The freshly baked milk bread released a rich creamy aroma. The cat purred softly beside the warm cloth, filling the entire kitchen with the cozy scent of warm butter and wheat.
diary_stage.entry3_content: I folded cinnamon and dried flowers into the dough today. As the oven warmed up, a gentle sweet aroma drifted through the kitchen, bringing warmth and quiet joy to the afternoon.
